selection.summary: Issue #1241: on first usage of a (re)initialized compression context, the matchstate window started at position 0, so the first input position could be treated as an invalid match reference. Fixed per the suggested approach: added MEM_STATIC ZSTD_window_init() in lib/compress/zstd_compress_internal.h, which zeroes the window but sets base/dictBase to an empty prefix and starts dictLimit/lowLimit/nextSrc at 1 (so the first input position is always a valid match reference, even during first context usage). Replaced the raw memset(&ms->window, 0, ...) in ZSTD_reset_matchState (lib/compress/zstd_compress.c) with ZSTD_window_init(&ms->window). This mirrors the upstream zstd fix for #1241; downstream ZSTD_window_update/window_clear logic then operates with non-zero starting indices.
